title: Okuwambatira Ensi
intro: Mu kiseera eky’okugezesebwa okunene, omuntu ow’ettutumu yaweebwa ebintu bingi nnyo eby’ensi, okugezesebwa okw’okwebaza n’obwetoowaze. Olugendo lw’omuntu ono lukola ng’essomo ery’amaanyi ku ngeri ebintu eby’omubiri gye biyitawo akaseera katono n’ebiva mu amalala. Bikkula ebikwata ku mwoyo guno emboozi yaayo ewandiikiddwa mu ttaka lyennyini wansi waffe.
clues: Nabeeranga mu bantu abaali balungamizibwa omubaka omukulu.
Allah yampa obugagga bungi nnyo ne kiba nti ebisumuluzo byennyini eby’obugagga byange byali mugugu munene eri abantu bangi ab’amaanyi.

Abantu bange, nga bamanyi obugagga bwange, bampa amagezi okunoonya obutuuze bw’enkomerero n’ebyo Allah bye yali ampadde n’obuteerabira mugabo gwange ogw’ensi, era nkole ebirungi nga Allah bwe yankolera ebirungi.
Nnalangirira n’amalala nti obugagga bwange obw’ekitalo bwatuusibwako okuyitira mu kumanya kwange kwokka n’okufuba kwange, nga nneegaana okusiimibwa kwonna okuva eri Katonda.
Bwe nnasabibwa okuwaayo oba okukkiriza ekirabo kya Allah, nnagaana n’amalala, nga nkkiririza nti ebintu byange byali byange byokka.
Olw’okwegulumiza kwange okuyitiridde n’okunyigirizibwa kwange, Allah yalagira ensi okuggulawo n’okumira n’okubeera kwange.
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
